Pricing based on volume and needs
Frequently asked questions
How does Attentive determine pricing?
Attentive's pricing is tailored to your business needs based on your message volume, subscriber list size, number of channels, and AI products selected.
Is it a credit-based model or pay-as-you-go? 
Attentive offers usage-based pricing, so you only pay for what you actually use—no credit system required.
Does Attentive offer any discounts or special pricing?
Yes, we offer discounts when you bundle multiple channels or premium AI products together to maximize value.
Does Attentive offer a free trial? 
Yes, we offer free trials. Fill out the form at the top of the page to get started today.
